story.iWant: automatically detect and install all project dependencies
story.soThat: users can set up the complete development environment without manual intervention
story.tasks:
Task 1: Dependency List Detection and Analysis (AC: 1) - [ ] Subtask 1.1: Create DependencyAnalyzer class to detect Python/Node.js dependency files - [ ] Subtask 1.2: Implement dependency version conflict detection algorithm - [ ] Subtask 1.3: Add database service dependency detection (Redis, PostgreSQL) - [ ] Subtask 1.4: Create dependency priority and installation order analysis
- [ ] Task 2: Intelligent Installation Method Selection (AC: 2) - [ ] Subtask 2.1: Extend DependencyInstaller to support online/offline mode switching - [ ] Subtask 2.2: Implement network connection detection and automatic mirror source selection - [ ] Subtask 2.3: Add offline package integrity verification and fallback mechanism - [ ] Subtask 2.4: Create installation strategy decision engine
- [ ] Task 3: Batch Dependency Installation Engine (AC: 3) - [ ] Subtask 3.1: Implement Python package batch installation (pip, conda) - [ ] Subtask 3.2: Implement Node.js module batch installation (npm, yarn) - [ ] Subtask 3.3: Add system dependency automatic installation (platform-specific) - [ ] Subtask 3.4: Implement parallel installation optimization and resource management
- [ ] Task 4: Version Conflict Handling (AC: 4) - [ ] Subtask 4.1: Create version compatibility checker - [ ] Subtask 4.2: Implement automatic version resolution and upgrade recommendations - [ ] Subtask 4.3: Add dependency locking mechanism and rollback functionality - [ ] Subtask 4.4: Create conflict report and solution generator
- [ ] Task 5: Progress Tracking and Error Handling (AC: 5) - [ ] Subtask 5.1: Integrate ProgressTracker to track installation progress - [ ] Subtask 5.2: Implement detailed error diagnosis and recovery recommendations - [ ] Subtask 5.3: Add installation logging and status persistence - [ ] Subtask 5.4: Create user-friendly progress display and feedback interface

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Automatically detect project dependency lists (Python requirements.txt, Node.js package.json, database services) 2. Intelligently select installation methods (online package managers vs offline installation packages) 3. Batch install Python packages, Node.js modules, and system dependencies 4. Handle version conflicts and dependency compatibility issues 5. Provide detailed installation progress feedback and error recovery mechanisms

constraints.constraint: 服务化架构，每个功能独立类，遵循core/services/utils分层结构
统一异常处理格式{code, message, solution, details}，用户友好的错误消息
支持Windows/macOS/Linux，平台特定的包管理器适配
设计为可安全多次运行的幂等操作
官方源下载和校验和验证，临时文件安全管理

tests.standards: 使用pytest进行Python测试，Jest进行Node.js测试。测试文件按test_*.py命名，放在tests/目录下。使用Mock模拟系统调用和外部依赖。目标测试覆盖率80%以上。使用parameterized测试进行多平台测试场景覆盖。
